title: Delivery Receipt Authorization Form
subtitle: Carrier Delivery Receipt: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Delivery Receipt Authorization Form binds transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the consignee / carrier authority's confirmation. The delivery operations coordinator records the requested Carrier Delivery Receipt action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Delivery Receipt Authorization Form at vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route. Reconcile applicable Carrier Delivery Receipt requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the consignee / carrier authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record.

sections.title: Decision context and authorization record
sections.guidance: For Carrier Delivery Receipt, identify responsible parties, vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route, and the linked transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record source.

fields.label: Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal
Piece, pallet, package, and consignee references

sections.title: Authorization basis and bounded decision
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Delivery Receipt facts for transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Authorization conditions and final decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Carrier Delivery Receipt conditions; have delivery operations coordinator assign the next Carrier Delivery Receipt owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Count, seal, or freight condition exception
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Delivery Receipt when count, condition, recipient authority, exception notation, or document custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Delivery Receipt proof and route unresolved transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record scope to delivery operations coordinator.
